name: Opal M365 MCP - per-user delegated Microsoft 365 gateway for Claude
description: Stand up and govern a shared property that lets Opal employees reach their own Microsoft 365 (email, OneDrive, SharePoint, calendar) from Claude. Architecture: a remote MCP gateway (Python, FastMCP Streamable HTTP, stateless) running on a nano EC2 behind an AWS-native access layer (ALB + authenticate-oidc against Entra), with per-user DELEGATED OAuth (MSAL confidential client; per-user Fernet-encrypted refresh token) so Graph enforces each user sees only their own data -- shared server, NEVER shared identity / never app-only. Guard middleware (pure-ASGI) enforces a global KILL_SWITCH + hot-reload per-user blocklist before any tool runs; every call audits to audit.jsonl (user/tool/redacted-args/outcome/ts). Most users connect via Claude Code (PowerShell); a GUI path is a later option over the same remote MCP (no per-machine install). A lighter local option (Lokka @merill/lokka Graph MCP + skills) is retained as the fast-start kit. Andrew-direct build session in the CVO Claude Code session 2026-06-10 (design+build collaboration); front-end leg PROVEN against a mock backend; routed to CTO to spin up this managing macro-project.
